events.title: Japantown Plus — social networking night
events.description: Japantown Cultural District's community networking night at KOHO. Open mic, DJ, mocktails. $5.

events.title: Japanese Language Lounge
events.description: Casual Japanese conversation, all levels. Twice monthly on Sundays; $15.

events.title: Japan Night 2027
events.description: Japan Society of Northern California's annual Japan Night reception.

events.title: Pitch window: Cherry Blossom talks/workshops
events.description: Pitch a talk or workshop for the April festival. Email info@nccbf.org and volunteer@nccbf.org; programming is usually set by February.

events.title: Signup watch: Cherry Blossom volunteers
events.description: Volunteer signup usually opens 6–8 weeks before the festival. Check sfcherryblossom.org/volunteers or email volunteer@nccbf.org.

events.title: Northern California Cherry Blossom Festival — weekend 1
events.description: Japantown's largest festival: food booths, performances, Grand Parade. 2027 dates come from third-party calendars; confirm at sfcherryblossom.org.

events.title: Northern California Cherry Blossom Festival — weekend 2
events.description: Second weekend, including the Grand Parade. 2027 dates come from third-party calendars; confirm at sfcherryblossom.org.

events.title: Pitch window: Nihonmachi Street Fair
events.description: Pitch a talk, performance or demo for the August street fair. Contact via nihonmachistreetfair.org.

events.title: Children's Day (Kodomo no Hi)
events.description: JCCCNC school visits, kimono dressing and festival programming. Volunteers needed.

events.title: Signup watch: Nihonmachi Street Fair
events.description: Volunteer and vendor signup usually opens in June for the August fair. Check nihonmachistreetfair.org.

events.title: Pitch window: TABEMASHO
events.description: Offer a talk, demo or auction item for JCCCNC's September fundraiser. Email programsevents@jcccnc.org.

events.title: Signup watch: TABEMASHO volunteers
events.description: Volunteer and auction-donor signup for the September fundraiser. Email programsevents@jcccnc.org.

events.title: Nihonmachi Street Fair (53rd)
events.description: Two-day Japantown street fair: taiko, food, arts, kids' area. About 40,000 attendees; volunteers needed.

events.title: TABEMASHO — JCCCNC annual fundraiser
events.description: JCCCNC's largest fundraiser. 2026 was Sept 19; 2027 date is tentative. Volunteers, auction items and sponsors needed.

events.title: JAYACon — Japantown community convention
events.description: Nikkei youth organizations and community leaders; panels and org tables. 2026 was Oct 3; 2027 date tentative.

events.title: JSNC Award of Honor Gala
events.description: Japan Society of Northern California's annual gala. 2026 was Oct 8; 2027 date tentative.

events.title: Japantown Halloween Carnival
events.description: JCCCNC and JCYC: crafts, performances, bounce house, costume parade. Volunteers needed. 2026 was Oct 30; 2027 date tentative.

events.title: Signup watch: Mochitsuki volunteers
events.description: Volunteer signup for the December mochi-pounding workshops. Email programsevents@jcccnc.org.

events.title: Mochitsuki workshops
events.description: Mochi-pounding workshops at JCCCNC. 2026 was Dec 19; 2027 date tentative. Volunteers needed.

watchlist.label: Japanese Chamber of Commerce of Northern California
watchlist.note: Wix Events site plus Eventbrite ticketing; no public ICS or JSON feed. Event pages are mostly Japanese-language.

watchlist.label: Consulate General of Japan in San Francisco
watchlist.note: Cultural and tech programmes are posted as news articles; the site blocks automated fetches and publishes no ICS.

watchlist.label: JCCCNC / The Center (Japantown)
watchlist.note: Community-centre workshops and special programmes; the site was unreachable from here and exposes no public calendar feed.

watchlist.label: Japantown Cultural District / JAYACon
watchlist.note: Squarespace site without an events collection or ICS endpoint; community panels are announced as pages.

watchlist.label: JETRO San Francisco
watchlist.note: Japan startup and innovation events; the site returns 403 to automated requests and offers no ICS.
